description.short: Explore synthetic sales with interactive MCP charts and drill-downs.
description.full: The declarative-agent edition of Foundry Charts. Ask about fictional 2025 revenue, profit, orders, and units; compare regions, countries, products, categories, and channels; and explore trends. Analysis comes from the Foundry Charts MCP server. Compatible Microsoft 365 Copilot clients display its interactive HTML/SVG MCP App with chart filters and drill-down controls. This demonstration does not read your organization's data and is not intended for financial decisions. Interactive rendering depends on client support and server availability.
